messages.subject: Re: Running Shiny App on a private server and accessing it via a URL
parts:
This isn't possible yet but will be soon, when we release the Shiny Server standalone software package. In the meantime, if you would like a beta account on glimmer.rstudio.com to host your own Shiny apps, you can sign up by going to http://rstudio.com/shiny and following the "register now" link in the second-to-last paragraph on that page.

Thanks!
